business_problem: Ryder needed to replace limited intranet and legacy employee systems that could not serve a 24/7, largely deskless workforce with timely HR and IT information, self-service, or coordinated case handling.
solution_summary: Ryder expanded its existing ServiceNow footprint into a unified employee-services layer by combining HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, and Employee Center Pro inside a new portal called MyRyder. The portal gives office and field employees mobile access to HR, IT, and later finance services from a single destination instead of separate departmental tools. Employees can search knowledge, submit questions, and track cases directly, while agents work with more structured intent and better shared visibility across teams. Because the platform centralizes service data, Ryder can identify the most common workforce questions and surface guided answers directly on the homepage, reducing the need for live intervention. The same environment now supports more than 60,000 self-service cases, faster chat handling, and knowledge reuse that was previously impossible when every team worked in its own silo.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Runs Ryder's automated HR-service workflows for a 24/7 employee population.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Provides the established IT support workflows that Ryder extended into a unified portal.

solution_components.name: Employee Center Pro
solution_components.role: Supplies the portal framework Ryder used to deliver one employee-services destination.

solution_components.name: MyRyder
solution_components.role: Presents knowledge, case intake, and cross-team employee support through one branded portal.

data_flow: Employees access MyRyder from the field or office to search knowledge, submit HR and IT requests, and track case progress. HR Service Delivery and IT Service Management process those requests on shared workflows, while knowledge content and guided homepage resources deflect common questions before agents need to step in.
business_outcome: Ryder increased HR agent efficiency by 80%, raised access to knowledge content by 91%, handled over 60,000 self-service cases in the second half of 2022, increased case volume by 10% with better intent, and cut chat wait times from 10 minutes to two minutes.
